audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Katarina/Skill/Skill while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Katarina, Katarina, Katarina. The full-layer whys for rows 0-3 also described Katarina winning those stages, arguing against the row they sit under.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame reaches 950 versus Katarina's 625 Bouncing Blade, and Mantra is available from level 1 without a skill point, so pre-6 is hers. Death Lotus at 6 is a fight-winning ultimate while Mantra only empowers a basic spell, which is the documented flip.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer and packet; phases[0..3].why rewritten in the same proposal so each sentence argues the Karma-favoured verdict it now sits under.

audit.why: Level 6 is the flip; first item is the burst spike that clears her Inspire shield in one rotation; late game her utility flatlines against reset chaining. Karma's own clock is Mantra at 40/38/36/34s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit and no real cooldown; the missingInteractions entry for this matchup — Karma cancelling Death Lotus with Focused Resolve and Mantra — was not stated in the Don'ts where it belongs; several Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Katarina's R carries the 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it' flag, and Karma's W is hardCC with Mantra extending the root duration. That is the decisive interaction of the matchup and it was absent from the page.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now names Focused Resolve at a flat 12s, Mantra at 40s down to 34s and Inner Flame at 9s rank 1; dontsFull[2].d now states the Lotus cancel explicitly; every bled body rewritten to match its own title.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave was the generic Katarina wave template with no Karma in it.
audit.why: The wave state that matters here is whether you have to walk into 950-range poke to last-hit, and whether she is stuck clearing.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Inner Flame's range and her slow waveclear.

audit.why: 54.67% over 5621 games, already on the page.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. It governs your forward steps. - E Shunpo (second use) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (Tether) is a flat 12s at every rank — break the tether with range before it completes, and never step up while it is available. - Mantra is 40s at rank 1 and 34s at rank 4; her whole threat sits on that clock. - Inner Flame is 9s at rank 1.

edits.after: Ahead, deny the poke: shove her in, roam off her slow waveclear, and take every 2v2 while Mantra sits on its 40s cooldown.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by punishing Mantra downtime — kill one target inside those 40 seconds and the reset chain does the rest.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave near a CC mage's tower — every pickup walk is a stun audition. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
edits.after: Best wave: shoved in, so she is stuck clearing under tower and her slow waveclear costs her the roam. Worst wave: a slow push you have to walk up to, straight into Inner Flame's 950-range poke. Crash timing: crash while Mantra is spent and take the roam — Karma follows late and loses plates for it.

edits.before: Karma wins by landing Focused Resolve (Tether), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Karma wins by poking you off the wave with Inner Flame before 6, then holding Focused Resolve to root you out of every Death Lotus.
